data.exact_reserve_text:
The 2018 & prior years of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 (2017 & prior years of account - collectable loss GBP 23,857,000).

The 2018 & prior years of account distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 consists of:
 A profit of GBP 10,988,000 in respect of 2018 pure year of account.
 A loss of GBP  (1,393,000) in respect of 2017 & prior years of accounts movements in 2020.
 A net adjustment of GBP 205,000 in respect of unearned premium.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2018 & prior years of account RITC closure
prior_year_events.impact_description: 2018 & prior years closed by Reinsurance to Close after 36 months with a distributable profit of GBP 9.8m (comprised of a profit of GBP 10.988m for 2018 and a loss of GBP 1.393m for 2017 & prior).

named_events.loss_description: Limited financial impact of Covid-19 claims (GBP 3.5m of Gross and Net provision).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release on prior years driven by favourable development across prior underwriting years (a net prior-year profit of c.GBP 17.9m), supported by benign claims activity and limited large loss experience. The 2018 & prior years closed by RITC with a distributable profit of GBP 9.8m (comprising a GBP 10.988m profit on 2018 and a GBP 1.393m loss on 2017 & prior). COVID-19 had a limited quantified impact (GBP 3.5m provision).
raw_causal_phrases: The 2020 year of account has developed favourably to date with a Gross Earned Loss Ratio at 45.2% and the Syndicate has benefited from a benign year with minimal large loss activity.
Limited financial impact of Covid-19 claims (GBP 3.5m of Gross and Net provision).

The 2018 & prior years of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 (2017 & prior years of account - collectable loss GBP 23,857,000).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from year-of-account result breakdown (sum of non-current-year components: 2019 YOA profit and 2018 & prior movements). A gross claims development triangle is present but the syndicate undertook an RITC (2018 & prior) which can distort comparisons; triangle exists in the notes and was cross-checked. Amounts in balance sheet and movement notes are in GBP 000; opening reserves taken from prior-year comparative column of the balance sheet. Lob-level prior-year movement amounts not separately disclosed; where unavailable amounts are null.
